posts.text:
The weights are available on Hugging Face as a 27 GB Q8_0 file that can run on a Mac through Nace's versions of llama.cpp and Ollama.

In Nace's test performed on an M5 Pro with 48 GB of memory, its answer probabilities for a sample request were within 0.02 of the full model
